## Project Tracker 1.1.7

- Milestones now appear as a vertical list directly below the project stats and target date.
- Newly added milestones append at the bottom and scroll into view. Tap a row to edit; long-press it for Edit / Delete options.
- New milestone percentages add to current progress as the next step, capped at 100%.
- Removed the simulated bottom gesture indicator while preserving the bottom spacing.
- The app icon uses a fluorescent rising graph on a flat black background.

The release includes the transparent project widget, local reminders, and local project storage. Project data stays on-device.

Download `Project-Tracker.apk`. It uses your private release key if GitHub Actions signing secrets are configured; otherwise it is debug-signed.
